name: Hyunjin Hwang

Citation block) and pyproject.toml carry no author emails and there is no CITATION.cff (404); (b) JinYeong Bak's HLI Lab at SKKU - the lab intro PDF https://skb.skku.edu/_res/skkuaai/etc/HLI.pdf prints per-member addresses (e.g. JaehyeokLee hjl8708@g.skku.edu, HyunJin Kim khyunjin1993@g.skku.edu, YeongJun Hwang hmtyj2@g.skku.edu) but lists NO Hyunjin Hwang, and hli.skku.edu itself is unreachable from this session (egress-blocked for fetching and the reader tool failed on /members); two WebSearch passes over the HLI member pages likewise surfaced no Hyunjin Hwang entry; (c) searches for '"Hyunjin Hwang" @g.skku.edu/@skku.edu/@kaist.ac.kr' and for a personal page/CV returned no printed address. Rejected candidates: the alphaXiv profile 'Hyunjin Hwang' (SLUG=hyunjin-hwang-2), which claims an AI PhD student at KAIST with a LinkedIn link - it auto-attaches this very paper but contradicts the paper's printed SKKU affiliation, and search shows a distinct KAIST-based Hyunjin Hwang publishing with Kijung Shin / Chanyoung Park on legal-document retrieval, i.e. a namesake merge; no address was taken from it. A Google Scholar 'verified email at <domain>' line, if any, would not count. No skku.edu pattern address was constructed.
